title: fanoutqa: List the female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category they won in. (dfc6679e70dc0854)

chat_history.content: List the female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category they won in.

content.content:
The user wants a list of female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category. Need to provide list. Need to ensure accurate information. Let's recall:

Nobel Prizes 2019 and 2020 winners.

2019 Nobel Prizes:

- Physics: James Peebles (male), Michel Mayor (male), Didier Queloz (male). No female.

- Chemistry: John B. Goodenough (male), M. Stanley Whittingham (male), Akira Yoshino (male). No female.

- Physiology or Medicine: William G. Kaelin Jr (male), Sir Peter J. Ratcliffe (male), Gregg L. Semenza (male). No female.

- Literature: Peter Handke (male). No female.

- Peace: Abiy Ahmed (male). No female.

- Economic Sciences: Abhijit Banerjee (male), Esther Duflo (female), Michael Kremer (male). So Esther Duflo is female.

2020 Nobel Prizes:

- Physics: Roger Penrose (male), Reinhard Genzel (male), Andrea Ghez (female). So Andrea Ghez is female.

- Chemistry: Emmanuelle Charpentier (female), Jennifer A. Doudna (female). Both female.

- Physiology or Medicine: Harvey J. Alter (male), Michael Houghton (male), Charles M. Rice (male). No female.

- Literature: Louise Glück (female). So female.

- Peace: World Food Programme (organization). No individual. No female.

- Economic Sciences: Paul R. Milgrom (male), Robert B. Wilson (male). No female.

Thus female winners across 2019 and 2020: Esther Duflo (Economic Sciences 2019), Andrea Ghez (Physics 2020), Emmanuelle Charpentier (Chemistry 2020), Jennifer A. Doudna (Chemistry 2020), Louise Glück (Literature 2020). Also there is also the 2020 Peace Prize to World Food Programme (organization), not a female. So list those.

Provide as a table: Year, Name, Category.

Make sure to mention that some categories had no female winners.

We don't need external lookup; we have knowledge. No need to use function.

Will answer accordingly.

content:
**Female Nobel Laureates (2019 – 2020)**  

| Year | Laureate | Nobel Category |
|------|----------|----------------|
| 2019 | **Esther Duflo** | Economic Sciences (jointly with Abhijit Banerjee & Michael Kremer) |
| 2020 | **Andrea Ghez** | Physics (jointly with Roger Penrose & Reinhard Genzel) |
| 2020 | **Emmanuelle Charpentier** | Chemistry (jointly with Jennifer A. Doudna) |
| 2020 | **Jennifer A. Doudna** | Chemistry (jointly with Emmanuelle Charpentier) |
| 2020 | **Louise Glück** | Literature (jointly with none – sole laureate) |

*Note:* In the other Nobel categories for 2019 and 2020 (Physics 2019, Chemistry 2019, Physiology or Medicine 2019‑2020, Peace 2019‑2020, Economic Sciences 2020) the laureates were all male or, in the case of the Peace Prize, an organization. The table above captures every individual female laureate from those two years.
